broker.name: InstaForex
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2007. Its site names FSC (BVI) and FSA (St Vincent). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:5000.
broker.about: InstaForex says it has operated since 2007. An address it publishes is 4th Floor, Water's Edge Building, Meridian Plaza, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands. Account names on its site include Insta.Standard, Insta.Pro, Insta.Zero, Insta.Raw, and Insta.Cent. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, IFXGear, and Mobile app. The site names these regulators: FSC (BVI) and FSA (St Vincent). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:5000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Account page also says leverage 1:1000 can be reduced to 1:600 when the balance is over 1000 USD.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: No single minimum. Account page: Insta.Standard and Insta.Cent from 1 USD; Insta.Pro, Insta.Zero and Insta.Raw from 100 USD. The comparison table also says the minimum deposit is 1 USD depending on the selected payment system.

other_fees.label: Insta.Zero and Insta.Raw commission
other_fees.note: Insta.Raw is described as a fixed commission of 0.5 USD. Standard, Pro and Cent show commission 0.
